description:
Before shipping Stripe Checkout code: pass, as params, EXACTLY the object your code passes to stripe.checkout.sessions.create (mode "subscription"). Checkbox evaluates it against automatic-renewal laws and returns correction.corrected_params — the full params with the fix applied, ready to paste — plus an RFC 6902 JSON patch and before/after verification per check.
With a Price id (price_…) in line_items, pass site (its plans are used) or merchant { price, interval, trial_days, merchant_name, cancel_url }.
Note: Stripe styles custom_text itself, so "clear and conspicuous" stays needs_review here; the plan shows it as a note, never a fix.

as_of.description: Evaluate the law as of this date, YYYY-MM-DD (default today).

jurisdictions.description: Where the business sells: "all" (default) or state codes like ["US-CA","US-NY"] ("CA" works too). Federal law is always included.

merchant.description: What the params do not say: merchant_name, cancel_url, and price/interval when line_items use a Price id.

cancel_timing.description: When a cancellation takes effect (default period_end).

cancel_url.description: https URL where subscribers cancel online (used in generated text).

interval.description: Billing interval: day, week, month or year.

intro_percent_off.description: Or the promo as % off (coupon percent_off).

trial_days.description: Free-trial days (0 or absent = no trial).

params.description: The Checkout Session params object, e.g. {"mode":"subscription","line_items":[{"price":"price_123","quantity":1}],"success_url":"https://acme.example/welcome"}.

plan.description: With site: plan name or price_…

site.description: site_… whose plans judge it (as verify_task)

name: check_stripe_checkout_session
title: Check Stripe Checkout Session params (returns corrected params)
